name: among us detailed set and character updated2
design:
A clean isometric sci-fi environment in a flat 2D Flash animation style like Among Us Game style. Character fidelity (CRITICAL):
- EXACT original Among Us crewmate design
- simple capsule-shaped body (rounded top, flat feet)
- NO arms, NO fingers, NO joints
- small backpack only
- no clothing details, no suit seams, no mechanical parts
- minimal design, smooth silhouette
- proportions identical to the original game
- visor is a simple glossy oval (light blue gradient with highlight)
- no added realism, no anatomy, no deformation (except zombie damage when specified)

Composition:
- multi-level structure with clear height difference (foreground platform + lower level)
- strong sense of depth using perspective layering
- camera angle slightly top-down isometric view (30–45 degrees)
- clean and logical layout (environment and activity naturally integrated)

Characters:
- Among Us style crewmates (yellow, red, etc.)
- simple capsule-shaped bodies
- no visible arms
- small backpack on the back
- glossy blue visor with highlight
- interacting naturally with environment (playing, operating machines, observing)

Line style (VERY IMPORTANT):
- thick, uniform black outlines
- vector-perfect linework
- smooth Bézier curve lines (no wobble, no jitter)
- no broken edges, no sketch lines
- consistent stroke width across entire image
- clean SVG-style paths
- anti-aliased edges, crisp and sharp
- no hand-drawn effect
- no roughness, no noise in lines

Color:
- slightly desaturated palette
- controlled saturation (no neon, no oversaturation)
- flat color fills with minimal soft shading
- no gradients except subtle visor highlight
- no texture, no grain, no dithering

Lighting:
- flat lighting
- evenly lit scene
- no realistic shadows or lighting effects

Environment design:
- simplified geometric sci-fi structures
- clean panels, modular walls, pipes, consoles
- functional layout that matches the scene (e.g., soccer field integrated naturally into interior)
- props must feel designed, not random
- avoid visual clutter

Style:
- flat cel-shaded 2D
- vector illustration look
- Flash / Toon Boom animation style
- mobile game asset quality
- clean UI-like design language

Depth:
- clear foreground / midground / background separation
- use scale and overlap (NOT shading) to express depth
- platforms, stairs, railings clearly define levels

Surface quality:
- smooth flat surfaces
- no brush texture
- no painterly rendering
- clean digital fill

Avoid:
- sketchy outlines
- uneven line thickness
- grain / noise / texture
- realistic shading
- complex rendering
- messy composition
